extra.message: User-controlled presentationPreset (from ExportPipelineSnapshotDto) is interpolated directly into a shell command string passed to execAsync(). An attacker can inject arbitrary shell commands (e.g. preset: "; rm -rf / #").

loadHandoffBundle() calls node:v8 deserialize() on a user-supplied blob (base64 submitted via the /deals/handoff endpoint). v8.deserialize on untrusted data allows arbitrary code execution / prototype corruption.

User-controlled outputFormat is concatenated into a pandoc command executed with execSync() (shell). Unlike renderEscalationBriefDocument, no allowlist check is applied here, so arbitrary shell commands can be injected.

User-controlled 'formula' is passed to new Function() and executed as JavaScript. This is arbitrary code execution on the server (e.g. formula: "process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync(...)").

admitByResourceCheck() uses jwt.decode() (no signature verification) on a 'signed' resource-check assertion. An attacker can forge a token with arbitrary organizationId/contactId and is admitted into a co-view session for any account (authentication bypass).

decodeQueueLayoutCookie() parses a <!DOCTYPE ... SYSTEM> entity from a user-controlled cookie and reads the referenced URI with fs.readFileSync(). A client can set the escalations_queue_layout cookie to SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd" to read arbitrary server files (XXE-style external entity expansion).

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: importFromSourceUrl() fetches a fully user-controlled sourceUrl with no hostname/IP validation. A staff user can make the server request internal endpoints (cloud metadata, internal services), i.e. SSRF.

reopenReviewerNote() joins a user-controlled noteFile into a path and reads it without basename sanitization (unlike saveReviewerNote which uses path.basename). Path traversal such as ../../../../etc/passwd reads arbitrary files.

loadBriefTemplate() builds a filesystem path from a user-controlled templateName (route param) with no traversal check (unlike documents.loadExportTemplate), then reads it. ../../ style traversal reads arbitrary files.

Portal wordmark upload uses multer diskStorage with filename = file.originalname (raw client filename, unsanitized). A crafted filename containing ../ writes the uploaded file outside the intended directory (path traversal / arbitrary file write).

advancedSearch() spreads free-form dto.filters into the TypeORM where clause after organizationId, so a caller can override organizationId (e.g. filters: {organizationId: '<other-org>'}) and read another organization's contacts (cross-tenant IDOR).

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: buildPortalGreetingSnippet() embeds user-controlled displayLabel into a <script> tag without escaping (contrast with contacts.buildContactBadgeSnippet which uses htmlEscape). Injects script/XSS into the portal greeting snippet.

cwe: CWE-80: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags

extra.message: buildEscalationBriefHtml() interpolates the escalation subject (customer-controllable via escalation creation) into raw HTML returned with Content-Type text/html. Stored XSS executes in the viewing staff member's browser.
buildAccountBriefHtml() interpolates the organization name into raw HTML returned with Content-Type text/html without HTML-escaping. Stored XSS if an org name contains markup.
invite-continue redirects to a fully user-controlled 'destination' query parameter with no validation/allowlist (contrast with logout-continue which validates against an allowlist). Open redirect.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site (Open Redirect)

extra.message: quickEditFields() uses Object.assign(esc, patch) with a free-form request body, letting a caller set arbitrary escalation fields (organizationId, assignedAgentId, status, internalNotes) bypassing status-transition and org-scoping checks.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: restoreAutosavedDraft() does Object.assign(deal, JSON.parse(draftJson)) with user-supplied JSON, allowing assignment of arbitrary deal fields (e.g. organizationId, stage) bypassing validation/transition rules.

cwe: CWE-915: Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes

extra.message: setDisplayName() updates the profile of an arbitrary dto.userId without verifying it matches the authenticated user (contrast with rotateOwnCredential which checks dto.userId === actor.id). Any authenticated user can change any other user's display name (IDOR).

cwe: CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

extra.message: queryEmployeeDirectory() concatenates the user-supplied 'term' directly into an LDAP filter (cn=*${term}*) without escaping (contrast with verifyGroupAccess which uses escapeFilterValue). LDAP injection.
searchLegacyManifest() concatenates the user-supplied 'term' into an XPath expression without escapeXPathString() (contrast with escalations.searchArchivedTranscripts which escapes). XPath injection.

cwe: CWE-643: Improper Neutralization of Data within XPath Expressions

extra.message: applyOverrides() recursively merges a user-controlled patch without blocking __proto__/constructor/prototype keys (contrast with applyOverridesSafe). Used by ApiKeysService.registerIntegrationOptions() with a free-form body, allowing prototype pollution of the shared defaults object.

cwe: CWE-1321: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes

extra.message: custom-view.csv sets a Content-Disposition header with the raw user-controlled 'viewLabel' query parameter (no CR/LF stripping or encoding). CRLF injection can add arbitrary response headers.
When presentation=worked is passed, the growth endpoint returns raw error.message and error.stack to the client, disclosing internal error details and stack traces.

cwe: CWE-209: Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information

extra.message: JWT signing/verification secret falls back to a hardcoded default 'dev-only-change-me' (repeated across auth, contacts, webhooks, escalations, documents, notifications). If JWT_SECRET is unset in production, attackers can forge admin JWTs and signed share/preview links.

findDuplicateUpload() builds a SQL query by string concatenation (organizationId, originalName, mimeType) instead of parameterized placeholders. Currently mitigated by upstream validation (UUID, sanitized name, allowlisted mimetype), but the pattern is an unsafe SQL-injection anti-pattern.
